verses.text: The LORD rules! Let the nations tremble. He sits on his throne between the cherubim. Let the earth shake.
The LORD is great in Zion. He is honoured above all the nations.
Let them praise your great and amazing name. He is holy!
The King is mighty and loves justice. You have set up fairness. You have done what is right and fair in Jacob.
Honour the LORD our God. Worship at his footstool. He is holy!
Moses and Aaron were among his priests. Samuel was among those who called on his name. They called to the LORD, and he answered them.
He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud. They kept the laws and rules he gave them.
LORD our God, you answered them. You were a God who forgave them, even though you punished them for their wrong actions.
Honour the LORD our God. Worship at his holy hill, because the LORD our God is holy!
